evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、clawmetry/adapters/base.py、clawmetry/adapters/cost.py、clawmetry/adapters/qwen_code.py、clawmetry/adapters/registry.py、clawmetry/approvals.py、clawmetry/behaviour_signals.py、clawmetry/endpoints.py、clawmetry/entitlements.py、clawmetry/providers_pricing.py、clawmetry/sync.py、clawmetry/telemetry.py、dashboard.py、docs/APPROVALS.md、docs/EGRESS.md、docs/compatibility.md、routes/agents.py、setup.py；[Q02](#research-q02)核通用adapter registry、capability、Session/Event、公开Qwen文件解析和API；DSH模块导入闭源reader，无法在本库闭合解析链。
limitations: 抽读根README/setup、entitlements、DSH module specs/import、dashboard登记、公共base/registry/Qwen/API、cost helper/pricing、behaviour、approvals、telemetry/endpoints及egress docs；不包含闭源DSHreader/全部LocalStore/crypto/服务安装和全部控制器。

findings.text: ClawMetry是独立Python/Web观测基础设施，读取编码Agent既有会话文件/日志，在统一看板回放会话、工具与运行时暴露的token/cost，帮助开发者或多Agent操作者分辨长运行与疑似卡住。它不是安装进DSH的原生插件，不提供DSH推理loop。合格结果应是找到准确原始事件、标明缺字段并减少诊断误判；活动量、重复调用或看板亮起都不证明任务有业务进展。
[Q02](#research-q02)核通用adapter registry、capability、Session/Event、公开Qwen文件解析和API；DSH模块导入闭源reader，无法在本库闭合解析链。

抽读根README/setup、entitlements、DSH module specs/import、dashboard登记、公共base/registry/Qwen/API、cost helper/pricing、behaviour、approvals、telemetry/endpoints及egress docs；不包含闭源DSHreader/全部LocalStore/crypto/服务安装和全部控制器。
独立Python/Web开源核心0.12.939，DSH等由闭源clawmetry-pro扩展；不是DSH原生插件。固定文档/代码有grace与expired条件，当前商业价格未查不引用。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python/Flask/DuckDB包 | 必需 | 本地服务与索引 | 固定源码声明Python>=3.8，目标环境未验 |
| 原runtime日志与权限 | 必需 | 会话/事件来源 | 检测/读取缺失不代表Agent没运行 |
| clawmetry-pro与合法权益 | DSH必需 | 闭源Beta读取器 | grace不提供缺失模块，到期可停用 |
| zstandard | DSH压缩数据条件需 | 作者称懒装读取 | 安装/解压链本次不可核 |
| connect/模型/控制hook | 可选 | 云同步/助手/阻断 | 分别增加外发、费用或设置修改 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Python依赖/closed授权金额未知 | 日志权限、reader/网络核查 | 不把免费OSS等同DSH免费 |
| 持续 | 读盘、索引存储、套餐/可选推理未知 | 格式升级、误报人审与保留策略 | 未证明节省诊断时间 |
| 失败 | 重建索引/坏文件排查未知 | 检查跳过数据/到期/companion加载 | 看板有数据不等全量 |
| 退出 | 本地/云留存资源未知 | 停daemon、撤权、卸hook/清归属数据 | pip卸载不等恢复设置 |
DSH先观察：核合法reader和无敏感样本、逐事件覆盖及网络/控制/退出。缺核心闭源材料或验收时保留原生回放，不把一般开源样例当DSH试用完成。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 统一观察 | 通用接口/公开adapter/API | DSHreader实际解析与兼容 |
| token/cost | 未知字段/估算逻辑可查 | 账单准确和异常零触达 |
| 轨迹信号 | 启发式可定位turn | 真卡住/任务质量与误报 |
| 风险控制 | reactive与pre-tool seam分开 | DSH实际事前阻断 |
capability/unknown、公共adapter失败隔离与扩展加载诊断可借鉴；DSHreader闭源、估算错误零/行为启发式和reactive控制限制要求结论绑定具体runtime。未全审巨大Python/Web应用或crypto。
[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)支持统一adapter/capability和可定位轨迹视图，公开样例有文件到API实现；不能由32目录或开源协议推出DSH读取器已审/可用，暂无独立诊断收益。
[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)最影响DSH采用的是reader在闭源companion、核心解析/控制不可核；观测不等事前阻断，估算零不总能证明免费，本地无sync也有条件外发。不能把所有保证从共享看板泛化。
[Q05](#research-q05)提出未验证的结论级覆盖/反证卡，将源缺失、跳过、成本性质和控制边界绑定结论；同轨迹测误判/诊断耗时，无收益则放弃，不计已有贡献。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)统一接口/capability相对手翻日志是常规适配novelty25%，保留unknown和适配失败隔离可条件迁移transfer50%；简化用户诊断入口但增加daemon/closed reader，仅simplification25%。DSH关键reader不在固定仓库[Q01](#research-q01)，无法判断其突破日志格式约束的mechanism，记null不补0、不用UI替代。Q05未来卡不计。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)相对多终端翻日志统一观察入口，workflow25%；轨迹/风险/估算视图便于交付诊断但未证明任务验收变化delivery25%；现有Agent操作者局部可达性reach25%；[Q04](#research-q04)仍需daemon/closed授权/原日志，未识别相对原生回放的成本结构增量economics0（不是把未知价格填零）。不推算省费或故障率。

recommendation.reason: DSH用户先核合法同版本companion和无敏感原日志样本，不把pip开源安装当DSH读取可用。逐事件对照覆盖、成本性质与实际控制，并隔离核默认/可选外发。核心reader或退出留存无法确认时维持原生回放，暂不导入生产轨迹。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README11-27明确多Agent长运行诊断、手翻日志基线和准确回查结果，超过8档偶发便利；未给真实操作者重复误判/原生不足直接证据，未到23档值得持续维护。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)base/registry/Qwen1024-1072与agents252-278支持统一结构/capability比6档入口有可解释增量；DSH闭源适配与诊断准确/跨runtime净效果未知，不到19档实质改善。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)sync15240-15245/15493-15502仅证明DSH闭源导入，虽[Q02](#research-q02)公开公共管线直接可核，DSH核心解析/实际识别/控制缺直接材料，只够6档固定片段而非13档核心完整；不是反驳所有观测价值故不0。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)entitlements864-883、egress27-90与setup说明DSH依赖授权/闭源、daemon/索引、条件外发和退出留存需人工确认，多项持续负担符合5档；可停止并回原生回放不至0档不可退，但companion/恢复退出未核不足10档。

结论状态 版本依据为 `dashboard.py:381` 的Python产品版本；根 `package.json` 的0.0.1仅属landing部署脚本包，不能当ClawMetry版本。 开源公共适配/成本/抑制与控制边界有固定源码，DSH核心reader属闭源依赖，本次未安装或验收。覆盖卡为未验证推演，不声称32适配均通过。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：ClawMetry是独立Python/Web观测基础设施，读取编码Agent既有会话文件/日志，在统一看板回放会话、工具与运行时暴露的token/cost，帮助开发者或多Agent操作者分辨长运行与疑似卡住。它不是安装进DSH的原生插件，不提供DSH推理loop。合格结果应是找到准确原始事件、标明缺字段并减少诊断误判；活动量、重复调用或看板亮起都不证明任务有业务进展。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)支持统一adapter/capability和可定位轨迹视图，公开样例有文件到API实现；不能由32目录或开源协议推出DSH读取器已审/可用，暂无独立诊断收益。 - **思考**：[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)最影响DSH采用的是reader在闭源companion、核心解析/控制不可核；观测不等事前阻断，估算零不总能证明免费，本地无sync也有条件外发。不能把所有保证从共享看板泛化。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05)提出未验证的结论级覆盖/反证卡，将源缺失、跳过、成本性质和控制边界绑定结论；同轨迹测误判/诊断耗时，无收益则放弃，不计已有贡献。 采用建议：DSH先观察：核合法reader和无敏感样本、逐事件覆盖及网络/控制/退出。缺核心闭源材料或验收时保留原生回放，不把一般开源样例当DSH试用完成。见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)支持统一adapter/capability和可定位轨迹视图，公开样例有文件到API实现；不能由32目录或开源协议推出DSH读取器已审/可用，暂无独立诊断收益。 ## 关键质疑 [Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)最影响DSH采用的是reader在闭源companion、核心解析/控制不可核；观测不等事前阻断，估算零不总能证明免费，本地无sync也有条件外发。不能把所有保证从共享看板泛化。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05)提出未验证的结论级覆盖/反证卡，将源缺失、跳过、成本性质和控制边界绑定结论；同轨迹测误判/诊断耗时，无收益则放弃，不计已有贡献。 未安装pip/companion、运行目标代码/测试、采集真实会话、调用模型/云、安装hooks或故障注入。文档wire capture/资格/支持矩阵不当独立验收。 ## 场景与替代办法 ClawMetry是独立Python/Web观测基础设施，读取编码Agent既有会话文件/日志，在统一看板回放会话、工具与运行时暴露的token/cost，帮助开发者或多Agent操作者分辨长运行与疑似卡住。它不是安装进DSH的原生插件，不提供DSH推理loop。合格结果应是找到准确原始事件、标明缺字段并减少诊断误判；活动量、重复调用或看板亮起都不证明任务有业务进展。 逐个runtime原生会话回放和JSONL/账单人工诊断；统一观测/事件/估算是成熟方法，DSH自身loop与权限未由本项目提供。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | Python/Flask/DuckDB包 | 必需 | 本地服务与索引 | 固定源码声明Python>=3.8，目标环境未验 | | 原runtime日志与权限 | 必需 | 会话/事件来源 | 检测/读取缺失不代表Agent没运行 | | clawmetry-pro与合法权益 | DSH必需 | 闭源Beta读取器 | grace不提供缺失模块，到期可停用 | | zstandard | DSH压缩数据条件需 | 作者称懒装读取 | 安装/解压链本次不可核 | | connect/模型/控制hook | 可选 | 云同步/助手/阻断 | 分别增加外发、费用或设置修改 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 选无敏感日志与隔离环境，核reader归属 | DSH合法companion/版本实际存在 | | 观察 | 保持no connect/no hook，核OFFLINE及网络 | 菜单出现不算读取通过 | | 对照 | 从看板逐事件回原文件与账单 | 标未知/估算/缺数，信号非任务结论 | | 退出 | 停daemon/撤connect授权/卸各自hook | 索引DB和云留存按归属单独处理 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | Python依赖/closed授权金额未知 | 日志权限、reader/网络核查 | 不把免费OSS等同DSH免费 | | 持续 | 读盘、索引存储、套餐/可选推理未知 | 格式升级、误报人审与保留策略 | 未证明节省诊断时间 | | 失败 | 重建索引/坏文件排查未知 | 检查跳过数据/到期/companion加载 | 看板有数据不等全量 | | 退出 | 本地/云留存资源未知 | 停daemon、撤权、卸hook/清归属数据 | pip卸载不等恢复设置 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 统一观察 | 通用接口/公开adapter/API | DSHreader实际解析与兼容 | | token/cost | 未知字段/估算逻辑可查 | 账单准确和异常零触达 | | 轨迹信号 | 启发式可定位turn | 真卡住/任务质量与误报 | | 风险控制 | reactive与pre-tool seam分开 | DSH实际事前阻断 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查独立跨runtime观测基础设施、DSH闭源接入、成本与控制及数据边界。 ### Q01 · 它为谁提供什么观测价值，DSH读取器是否在开源包中？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 ClawMetry是独立Python/Web观测基础设施，读取编码Agent既有会话文件/日志，在统一看板回放会话、工具与运行时暴露的token/cost，帮助开发者或多Agent操作者分辨长运行与疑似卡住。它不是安装进DSH的原生插件，不提供DSH推理loop。合格结果应是找到准确原始事件、标明缺字段并减少诊断误判；活动量、重复调用或看板亮起都不证明任务有业务进展。 相对逐个终端翻原生JSONL，增量是统一适配、capability面板与跨运行时定位，原生会话文件与成本字段来自被观测者。README称支持32运行时，但免费开源只带OpenClaw、NemoClaw、Goose和Qwen Code；DSH属于clawmetry-pro闭源companion。sync规格明确导入clawmetry_pro.adapters.deepseek_harness，缺失/坏模块被跳过，所以目录宣称和grace允许都不会凭空提供读取器。 DSH兼容矩阵标Beta、默认zstd会话、转录/model/tool calls和检测后懒装zstandard，这是作者声明与导入注释，本次无法核闭源解析实现、DSH cost或全数据覆盖。不能把开源MIT或32目录数写成32个独立验证适配。只用单一运行时且原生回放足够的用户未必值得加守护进程。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:11-27](https://github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/blob/46d18ffe35c361bb40b35782fd53db699636321f/README.md#L11-L27) 作者定位既有日志观测和默认本地服务。

查看原文（34行） ```text """Behaviour Signals: what people and agents *say* about a run (WO-58). Guard reads the tool stream to ask "is the agent stuck?". This module reads the words in the same transcripts to ask "is the agent frustrating the person using it, and is it giving up on them?". Six preset signals, each a binary match against ONE turn of a session: user_frustration the person swears at or corrects the agent user_praise the person says thanks / perfect / nice assistant_refusal the agent declines ("I can't help with", "as an AI") assistant_laziness the agent hands the work back ("you can do this manually", "left as an exercise", TODO placeholders) task_failure the agent says it could not finish user_retry the person re-sends substantially the same request Rules this module enforces: * **Judge-free.** Every matcher is a precompiled regular expression or a small structural check (token Jaccard between consecutive user turns). There is no LLM on this path and there never will be on the hot path. * **The matched text is never stored.** A match record carries the signal name, the turn reference, the matcher that fired and a short category. A stored "this sucks" next to a developer's name is a privacy problem, so matches point at the turn and the transcript viewer shows it under the existing access rules. * **Bounded per tick.** The daemon scans at most ``MAX_EVENTS_PER_TICK`` turn events per pass, reads at most ``SCAN_CAP_CHARS`` of each turn, and advances a watermark on ``events.created_at`` so a turn is evaluated once. * **Coverage is stated, never implied.** A runtime that does not write user prompts to disk reports ``user_text: false`` and the surface says "not exposed by this runtime" rather than 0%. * **Precision over recall.** Word boundaries everywhere, a negation guard ("not bad", "this doesn't suck") and a positive-context guard ("pretty damn good") on the profanity group. "kill the process" matches nothing. ```

      "content": "# ClawMetry\n\n[![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/clawmetry?color=E5443A&label=version)](https://pypi.org/project/clawmetry/)\n[![PyPI Downloads](https://static.pepy.tech/badge/clawmetry)](https://clickpy.clickhouse.com/dashboard/clawmetry)\n[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/vivekchand/clawmetry?style=flat&color=E5443A)](https://github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/stargazers)\n[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)\n[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry)\n[![Security policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/security-policy-informational)](SECURITY.md)\n[![Egress: documented](https://img.shields.io/badge/egress-documented-informational)](docs/EGRESS.md)\n\n**An agent can make a hundred tool calls without making progress.** ClawMetry\nreads the session files your coding agents already write, and puts the timeline,\nthe tool calls and whatever token and cost data the runtime exposes into one\nview — so you can tell a long run that is working from one that is stuck.\n\nWorks with **32 AI agent runtimes** — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw & 28 more. One dashboard for your whole agent fleet. ([the full list](SUPPORTED_RUNTIMES.txt), generated from the catalogue.)\n\n> 🌐 **Read this in:** [English](README.md) · [简体中文](docs/i18n/zh-CN/README.md) · [日本語](docs/i18n/ja/README.md) · [한국어](docs/i18n/ko/README.md) · [Español](docs/i18n/es/README.md) · [Português (BR)](docs/i18n/pt-BR/README.md) · [Français](docs/i18n/fr/README.md) · [Deutsch](docs/i18n/de/README.md) · [हिन्दी](docs/i18n/hi/README.md) · [العربية](docs/i18n/ar/README.md) · [Русский](docs/i18n/ru/README.md) · [more →](docs/i18n/)\n\nOne command. Zero config. Auto-detects everything.\n\n```bash\npip install clawmetry && clawmetry\n```\n\nOpens at **http://localhost:8900**. Zero config: it finds the agent runtimes\nyou already have, reads them read-only, and changes nothing about how they run.\n\n![ClawMetry dashboard: every AI agent runtime on one machine with 24h and lifetime cost per agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/hero.png)\n\n## Before you install\n\n| | |\n|---|---|\n| **What it does** | Reads the session files and logs your agents already write. No SDK, no code change, no instrumentation in your app. |\n| **What you see** | Session timeline, tool-by-tool replay, token and cost breakdown, and trajectory signals (looping, repeated failures) — per runtime. |\n| **What's free** | `pip install clawmetry` reads **OpenClaw, NVIDIA NemoClaw, Goose and Qwen Code** with no account, no key and no network call. The other 28 — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and the rest — are read by the closed-source `clawmetry-pro` companion, which arrives with the 7-day trial or a plan — see [docs/ENTITLEMENTS.md](docs/ENTITLEMENTS.md) for the exact split. |\n| **How to start** | `pip install clawmetry && clawmetry`, then open localhost:8900. No agents on this machine yet? `clawmetry --sample` opens on three labelled synthetic sessions. |\n| **What leaves your machine** | No session data, unless you run `clawmetry connect`. Two things do run by default, both opt-out and neither carrying session content: an anonymous install ping and a PyPI version check. Every destination is inventoried in [docs/EGRESS.md](docs/EGRESS.md), rebuilt from a wire capture rather than from reading comments. |\n\nTwo limits worth knowing before you judge the output: runtimes expose very\ndifferent data (some publish no cost at all — [the matrix](docs/compatibility.md)\nsays which, per runtime), and observing an action is not the same as being able\nto block it ([which controls are real, per runtime](docs/APPROVALS.md)).\n\n\n## Works with 32 agent runtimes\n\n**Free in the open source app:** 🦞 **[OpenClaw](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/openclaw)** · 🟩 **[NVIDIA NemoClaw](https://clawmetry.com/nemoclaw)** · 🪿 **[Goose](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/goose)** · ◈ **[Qwen Code](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/qwen-code)**\n\n**On a paid plan:** ◆ **[Claude Code](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/claude-code)** · **[Cursor](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/cursor)** · 🐙 **[GitHub Copilot](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/copilot)** · ⬡ **[OpenAI Codex](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/codex)** · ♊ **[Gemini CLI](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/gemini-cli)** · 💗 **[Lovable](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/lovable)** · ⠕ **[Replit Agent](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/replit)** · 🖇 **[Cline](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/cline)** · 🙌 **[OpenHands](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/openhands)** · 🧑‍💼 **[OpenWorker](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/openworker)** · 🎭 **[Muse Code](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/muse-code)** · 🏛️ **[OpenExecutive](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/openexecutive)** · **[opencode](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/opencode)** · **[Aider](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/aider)** · 🔗 **[n8n](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/n8n)** · 🅳 **[Devin](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/devin)** · 🪐 **[Antigravity](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/antigravity)** · **[Grok Build](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/grok)** · 🤖 **[Grok Bot](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/grok-bot)** · ⚡ **[Hermes](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/hermes)** · **[Pi](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/pi)** · **[Deep Agents](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/deep-agents)** · 🌙 **[Kimi CLI](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/kimi)** · 🐋 **[DeepSeek Harness](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/deepseek-harness)** · 🦾 **[Exo](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/exo)** · **[NanoClaw](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/nanoclaw)** · **[PicoClaw](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/picoclaw)** · **[QM](https://clawmetry.com/runtimes/qm)**\n\nEvery runtime gets the same dashboard. Run several at once and the header\nswitcher re-scopes every tab to one of them.\n\nBuilt your own agent on an SDK instead? The interceptor tracks its LLM calls\ntoo. See [docs/SDK_TRACKING.md](docs/SDK_TRACKING.md).\n\nBuilding with a humanoid robot? The free, open-source\n[Asimov 1 connector](docs/ASIMOV.md) imports Menlo SDK recordings and provides\nan optional observation collector and application tracing. This support is\nexperimental. Physical hardware qualification is pending.\n\n[Jumper observation](docs/JUMPER.md) is also built into the same open-source\npackage. Its application telemetry, task decisions and incidents appear in the\nshared Physical AI view. Mizu's separate scene and skills demo imports this\nbuilt-in adapter; it is not another observer plugin to install.\n\n## What you get\n\n- **Sessions & transcripts**: what each agent did, turn by turn, with replay\n- **Cost & tokens**: per runtime, model, session and day, with anomaly flags\n- **Flow**: live diagram of messages moving through channels, models and tools\n- **Brain**: the reasoning and tool-call event stream as it happens\n- **Context blowout**: window utilization sized per provider, compaction vs forced overflow, plus a per-runtime map of what we *can't* see ([how](docs/CONTEXT_BLOWOUT.md))\n- **Memory & skills**: the files and skills each runtime actually loaded\n- **Health & logs**: disk, memory, error rates, rate limits, live log stream\n- **Alerts**: budget caps, error spikes, agent-offline, routed to Slack, Discord, PagerDuty, Telegram, Email\n- **Approvals**: pause risky tool calls *before* they run and approve from your phone ([how](docs/APPROVALS.md))\n\n## Context blowout, and what watching costs\n\nTwo questions worth answering before you trust any agent-comparison tool.\n\n**How does it handle context-window blowout across runtimes?**\n\nA utilization percentage is only as honest as what it divides by. ClawMetry\nsizes the window per provider from [a table you can read and\nPR](clawmetry/context_windows.py), covering Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI,\nDeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Mistral, Llama and GLM. It does not measure all 32\nruntimes with one vendor's ruler. That matters: a 300K GPT-5 turn scored\nagainst Anthropic's 200K reads \">100%, blown\" when it is really at 75% of\nGPT-5's 400K. The same ruler hides a genuinely overflowed 130K DeepSeek turn\nas a comfortable 65%.\n\nEvery window ships with its provenance: `model_table`, `explicit_marker`,\n`observed_floor`, or an honest `default` when we don't know the model. A\ngauge built on a guess never renders with the same authority as one built on\na lookup.\n\nClawMetry can only see compaction events on some runtimes. So\n`GET /api/context-coverage` reports, per runtime, whether a **zero means\n\"ran clean\" or \"we're blind\"**. A `0` that actually means blind says so.\n[Full detail](docs/CONTEXT_BLOWOUT.md)\n\n**What does the instrumentation cost?**\n\n| Path | Added to your agent | Default? |\n|---|---|---|\n| Session-file tailing (all 32 runtimes) | **0**. Separate process, no ClawMetry code in your agent | on |\n| HTTP interceptor (`CLAWMETRY_INTERCEPT=1`) | **+0.44 ms** per LLM call, or 0.009% of a 5s call | off |\n| Pre-tool hook gate (warm cache) | **+44 ms** per gated tool call, over a 36 ms interpreter floor | off |\n| Enforcement proxy | **+9.7 ms** per LLM call | off |\n\nDaemon host cost: **2,762 events/sec** ingest, **710 bytes/event** on disk\n(67.7 MB per 100k events), and **~12% of one core** sustained on a busy\ninstall. That last number is over our own stated 5-10% budget, so it is\npublished as a bug to chase rather than left off the page.\n\nMeasured on an Apple M2 Pro with `benchmarks/overhead.py`. The harness runs\neach condition in a separate process, alternates their order, and **refuses\nto print a number when the rounds disagree on its sign**. Run it on your own\nmachine in a minute:\n\n```bash\npip install clawmetry && python -m benchmarks.overhead\n```\n\nEvery path is measured, including the hook gates and the enforcement proxy,\nand the harness runs on Linux, macOS and Windows in CI. Two results worth\nknowing: the proxy costs about seven times more on Windows than on Linux, and\nthe daemon currently sustains about 12% of one core, over our own 5-10%\nbudget. The raw JSON, the method, and what is still unmeasured are in\n[docs/OVERHEAD.md](docs/OVERHEAD.md).\n\n## Pricing\n\n| Plan | What it covers | Price |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Free** | OpenClaw + NVIDIA NemoClaw + Goose + Qwen Code, full dashboard, local only | $0 |\n| **Starter** | Every other runtime above, fleet view, cloud sync | $9 per node / month |\n| **Pro** | Starter + control and evaluation: approvals, tool-risk policies, evals, anomaly detection, cost optimizer, OTel export, tamper-evident audit log | $19 per node / month |\n\nAnnual plans, Enterprise and the current numbers live at\n**[clawmetry.com/pricing](https://clawmetry.com/pricing)**. Self-hosted license\nkeys work without the cloud (`clawmetry license`). The exact free/paid split is\nin [docs/ENTITLEMENTS.md](docs/ENTITLEMENTS.md).\n\n## Your data stays on your machine\n\nClawMetry reads local session files and logs. **No session data leaves your box\nunless you run `clawmetry connect`** — no prompts, replies, tool arguments, file\ncontents or log lines. When you do connect, the snapshot is end-to-end encrypted\nwith a key that never leaves your machine, and decrypted in your browser. If a\nnode has no key, the upload is skipped rather than sent in the clear, and no\nserver response can turn that off.\n\nTwo things do run by default before you connect, both opt-out and neither\ncarrying session data: an anonymous install ping and a version check against\nPyPI. A default install also looks up your public IP once for a startup banner\nline. Every destination, what it carries and how to switch it off is listed in\n[docs/EGRESS.md](docs/EGRESS.md); self-hosted, repointed and air-gapped installs\nmake no discretionary outbound calls at all.\n\nThe decryption happens in your browser, in code we serve you. That used to be\na promise; it is now something you can check. Every line that touches your key\nlives in one readable file, [`clawmetry/static/js/cm-e2e.js`](clawmetry/static/js/cm-e2e.js),\nwhich ships inside the wheel and is served verbatim, pinned with a Subresource\nIntegrity hash. To confirm the browser runs what we published:\n\n```bash\ncurl -s https://app.clawmetry.com/static/js/cm-e2e.js -o served.js\npip download --no-deps clawmetry==$(clawmetry --version | tr -d 'a-z ') -d /tmp/cm\nunzip -p /tmp/cm/clawmetry-*.whl clawmetry/static/js/cm-e2e.js > published.js\ndiff served.js published.js && echo identical\n```\n\nWhat that does not prove: we serve the page that loads the file, so we could\nserve a different page. Integrity hashes protect you from a compromised CDN,\nnot from the vendor. What you gain is that any substitution has to be\ndeliberate, visible in the page source, and different from an artifact on PyPI\nthat anyone can fetch. Self-hosting or staying local-only removes the\ndependency entirely.\n\n## Install\n\n```bash\npip install clawmetry     # then: clawmetry\n```\n\nOr the one-liner: `curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/install.sh | bash`\n\nNeeds Python 3.8+ on macOS, Linux or Windows, and at least one agent runtime on\nthe same machine. Docker instructions: [docs/DOCKER.md](docs/DOCKER.md).\n\nOr let the agent set it up for you. The [`agent-kill-switch`](skills/agent-kill-switch/SKILL.md)\nskill teaches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot or OpenCode to\ninstall ClawMetry, report what the agents on the machine are doing and spending,\nstop one session on request, and hold risky tool calls for approval:\n\n```bash\nnpx skills add vivekchand/clawmetry --skill agent-kill-switch\n```\n\n## Docs\n\n| | |\n|---|---|\n| [Runtime compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) | What each adapter reads, and how to add a runtime |\n| [Context blowout](docs/CONTEXT_BLOWOUT.md) | Per-provider windows, compaction vs overflow, per-runtime coverage |\n| [Overhead](docs/OVERHEAD.md) | What instrumentation costs, measured, with the harness to reproduce it |\n| [Entitlements](docs/ENTITLEMENTS.md) | Free vs paid, tier matrix, license CLI |\n| [Approvals & policies](docs/APPROVALS.md) | Pre-execution gating, risk scoring, phone approvals |\n| [OpenTelemetry](docs/OPENTELEMETRY.md) | Export traces anywhere, ingest OTLP from anything |\n| [Bring your own agent](docs/BRING_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md) | AWS AgentCore, Pydantic AI, LangChain end to end, with runnable examples |\n| [SDK tracking](docs/SDK_TRACKING.md) | Cost attribution for agents you built yourself |\n| [Chat channels](docs/CHANNELS.md) | The chat adapters shown in Flow |\n| [NemoClaw / OpenShell](docs/NEMOCLAW.md) | Sandboxed NVIDIA NemoClaw setups |\n| [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) | Image, compose, volume mounts |\n| [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) | How it works inside; running from source |\n| [Telemetry](docs/TELEMETRY.md) | The anonymous install and desktop-open pings, and how to turn them off |\n\n## Screenshots\n\nEvery number below is from one real machine, read-only, with nothing seeded.\n\n**It tells you when something is wrong, not just what happened.**\nTwo anomaly banners at the top: spend running 7x the daily average, and a\n4.2x cost spike. Below them, 324 of 667 recent sessions carrying a waste\nsignal, itemised by cause.\n\n![Overview: spending anomaly and cost spike banners over live agent work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/overview.png)\n\n**It shows you where the money went, in every window.**\n$252.47 today, $513.15 this week, $1,312.92 this month, each with the tokens\nbehind it and how much of it your subscription already covers. Below that,\nabout $1,128/mo itemised as recoverable and $17,256/mo already saved by\ncache reuse.\n\n![Cost: today, this week and this month, with an efficiency grade and itemised savings ideas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/cost.png)\n\n**It draws how a message becomes an answer.**\nThe live flow diagram: you, the channel it arrived on, the gateway, the model\nanswering right now, and every tool it reached for. Nodes light up as work\nmoves through them.\n\n![Flow: live diagram from you through the gateway to the model and its tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/flow.png)\n\n**Every agent on the machine, in one table.**\nWhat it runs, what it costs in the last 24 hours and over its lifetime, when\nit was last seen, who owns it, and whether a subscription is covering the\nbill. 14 agents here, 3 sessions working, 13 quiet.\n\n![Agents: every runtime on the machine with cost, owner, last seen and current work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/agents.png)\n\n**It shows where a turn's time and money went, tool by tool.**\nOne turn of a real session: 11 tools in 11.2 minutes for $1.16. Every Bash\ncall and model call gets its own bar on the timeline, so the command that ran\nfor 4.1 minutes and the one that ran for 226ms are told apart at a glance.\n\n![Sessions: one agent turn on a timeline, every tool call with its own duration and the turn's cost](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/sessions.png)\n\n**It grades the work, not just the spend.**\nAn A this week: 54 tasks came back clean, 2 rough ones cost $48.57, and the\nruns with too little activity to judge are left out of the grade instead of\nbeing counted as wins. Each rough run links to its trace.\n\n![Quality: this week's report card with the rough runs and what they cost](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/quality.png)\n\n**It shows why the context window keeps filling up.**\n715K of a 1M-token window on the latest turn, an 83.3% peak, 4 compactions\nthat all fired proactively rather than on an overflow, and the utilisation of\nevery turn behind it.\n\n![Context usage: window utilisation per turn, compaction events and tokens reclaimed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/context.png)\n\n**Detection runs without you configuring anything.**\nThe built-in detectors are on from install: agent went quiet, telemetry feed\nstopped, cost spike, token burst, errors climbing, error spike, budget\nthreshold, threat signature matched, security tool finding, security posture\nchanged. Your own rules are optional on top.\n\n![Alerts: built-in detectors plus optional custom rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/alerts.png)\n\n**Holding a risky call is opt-in, and ships off.**\nRecursive deletes, force pushes, sudo, secrets, package installs and outbound\ncalls each get a rule you can turn on. Until you do, ClawMetry watches and\nchanges nothing. Once one is on, matching calls wait here (or on your phone)\nfor an approve or a deny.\n\n![Approvals: protection rules for risky tool calls, all off until you enable them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/main/screenshots/approvals.png)\n\nMore, per runtime: [docs/RUNTIME_SCREENSHOTS.md](docs/RUNTIME_SCREENSHOTS.md).\n\n## Recognition\n\n<a href=\"https://www.producthunt.com/products/clawmetry?embed=true&utm_source=badge-top-post-badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=badge-clawmetry-for-openclaw\" target=\"_blank\"><img src=\"https://api.producthunt.com/widgets/embed-image/v1/top-post-badge.svg?post_id=1081207&theme=light&period=daily&t=1771491508782\" alt=\"ClawMetry - #5 Product of the Day on Product Hunt\" width=\"250\" height=\"54\" /></a>\n\n\n## Star History\n\n<a href=\"https://www.star-history.com/?repos=vivekchand%2Fclawmetry&type=date&legend=top-left\">\n <picture>\n <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://api.star-history.com/image?repos=vivekchand/clawmetry&type=date&theme=dark&legend=top-left\" />\n <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://api.star-history.com/image?repos=vivekchand/clawmetry&type=date&legend=top-left\" />\n <img alt=\"Star History Chart\" src=\"https://api.star-history.com/image?repos=vivekchand/clawmetry&type=date&legend=top-left\" />\n </picture>\n</a>\n\n## License\n\nMIT · Built by [@vivekchand](https://github.com/vivekchand) · [clawmetry.com](https://clawmetry.com)\n\n<!-- osai-verify: f3ac716d40002c1ad6dd -->\n"

      "content": "\"\"\"Adapter base class + unified schemas.\n\nEvery agent framework (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …)\nimplements :class:`AgentAdapter` and translates its native data into the\nshared :class:`Session` / :class:`Event` shapes below. The\n``capabilities()`` set tells the UI which panels to render.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom abc import ABC, abstractmethod\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Iterator\n\nfrom . import phase as _phase\n\n\nclass Capability(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"UI/data capabilities an adapter may expose.\n\n    The dashboard gates panels by these.       "content": "\"\"\"Shared cost-derivation helper for the bundled runtime adapters.\n\nSingle source of truth for \"given tokens + a model, what did this cost?\".\nWraps the cache-aware pricing path (``clawmetry.providers_pricing.\nestimate_event_cost_usd``), which:\n  * resolves the provider from the model name when provider is \"\" / None,\n  * applies Anthropic prompt-cache multipliers (read 0.1x, write 1.25x input),\n  * resolves local / self-hosted models (ollama/llama/qwen/...) to a real 0.0,\n  * never raises (returns 0.0 on any internal error).\n\nWe layer one extra rule on top that the pricing function does NOT enforce:\nreturn ``None`` (not 0.0) when there is genuinely nothing to price -- no\nmodel, or no billable tokens at all. That preserves each adapter's honesty\ncontract (cost_usd=None == \"unknown\", distinct from a real 0.0 for a free\nlocal model).\n\nLeaf module (no intra-package imports) so every adapter can import it without\ncircular-import risk. Nothing here raises.\n\nThis lives in OSS because the Free runtime adapters bundled here need it.\n``clawmetry_pro.lib.cost`` carries a byte-identical implementation for the\npaid adapters; the two are kept in lockstep by\n``tests/test_adapter_cost_helper.py``.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Optional\n\ntry:\n    from clawmetry.providers_pricing import estimate_event_cost_usd\nexcept Exception:  # pragma: no cover - pricing always ships with clawmetry\n    estimate_event_cost_usd = None  # type: ignore[assignment]\n\n\ndef _coerce_int(value) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Best-effort non-negative int; 0 for anything non-numeric/None.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        if isinstance(value, bool):\n            return 0\n        n = int(value)\n        return n if n > 0 else 0\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return 0\n\n\ndef derive_cost_usd(\n    model: str,\n    input_tokens: int = 0,\n    output_tokens: int = 0,\n    cache_read: int = 0,\n    cache_write: int = 0,\n    provider: Optional[str] = None,\n) -> Optional[float]:\n    \"\"\"Derive per-session/-event cost in USD from a model + token split.\n\n    Reuses the cache-aware pricing path. The provider is resolved from the\n    model name automatically when ``provider`` is None/\"\" -- callers do NOT\n    need to pre-resolve it.\n\n    Returns:\n        float: the derived cost (>= 0.0). A legitimate ``0.0`` is returned for\n               local / self-hosted models (the user pays for hardware, not per\n               token) -- a real, correct cost, not \"unknown\".\n        None:  only when pricing is genuinely impossible -- the pricing path is\n               unavailable, the model is empty/missing, or there are zero\n               billable tokens (input + output + cache_read + cache_write all 0).\n\n    Never raises.\n    \"\"\"\n    if estimate_event_cost_usd is None:\n        return None\n\n    model = (model or \"\").strip()\n    if not model:\n        return None\n\n    in_tok = _coerce_int(input_tokens)\n    out_tok = _coerce_int(output_tokens)\n    cr_tok = _coerce_int(cache_read)\n    cw_tok = _coerce_int(cache_write)\n\n    # Nothing to price -- keep the adapter's honest \"unknown\" (None); don't\n    # fabricate a 0.0 that would read as \"this turn was free\".\n    if not (in_tok or out_tok or cr_tok or cw_tok):\n        return None\n\n    try:\n        cost = estimate_event_cost_usd(\n            model,\n            input_tokens=in_tok,\n            output_tokens=out_tok,\n            cache_read_tokens=cr_tok,\n            cache_write_tokens=cw_tok,\n            provider=provider or \"\",\n        )\n    except Exception:\n        return None\n\n    # estimate_event_cost_usd never raises and returns a float; 0.0 here is a\n    # *real* cost (local model, or a known provider with a zero-rate model),\n    # so return it as-is rather than collapsing it to None.\n    try:\n        return float(cost)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n"

      "content": "\"\"\"QwenCodeAdapter — read Qwen Code chat-recording history from disk.\n\nQwen Code (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code) is Alibaba's open-source\ncoding CLI, a fork of Google's Gemini CLI. It supports any OpenAI-compatible\nprovider (Qwen API, OpenRouter, a local Ollama ``/v1`` endpoint, ...) via the\n``OPENAI_API_KEY`` / ``OPENAI_BASE_URL`` / ``OPENAI_MODEL`` env vars.\n\nLike the Claude Code and PicoClaw adapters, this is a non-OpenClaw filesystem\nreader that subclasses :class:`AgentAdapter` directly. The native format is\nQwen Code's own Gemini-CLI-lineage chat recording, NOT OpenClaw's v3 envelope.\n\nOn-disk layout\n--------------\nChat recording is written (when enabled with ``--chat-recording`` or the\n``general.chatRecording`` setting) under the per-project directory::\n\n    ~/.qwen/projects/<project-hash>/chats/<sessionId>.jsonl\n\n``<project-hash>`` is the working-directory path with ``/`` replaced by ``-``\n(e.g. ``-private-tmp-qwen-real-run``). One ``.jsonl`` file per session; one\nJSON record per line.\n\nEach line is a record with a flat envelope plus a nested ``message``::\n\n    {\n      \"uuid\": \"...\",                 # this record's id\n      \"parentUuid\": \"...\" | null,    # previous record (a chain, not a tree)\n      \"sessionId\": \"...\",            # == the file's basename\n      \"timestamp\": \"2026-05-25T20:41:03.715Z\",   # ISO-8601, UTC \"Z\"\n      \"type\": \"user\" | \"assistant\" | \"tool_result\" | \"system\",\n      \"cwd\": \"...\",\n      \"version\": \"0.16.1\",\n      \"model\": \"qwen3:8b\",           # present on assistant records\n      \"message\": { \"role\": ..., \"parts\": [ ... ] },\n      \"usageMetadata\": { ... }       # present on assistant records\n    }\n\nThe ``message.parts`` array is the Gemini ``Content.parts`` shape:\n  - user text:        ``{\"text\": \"...\"}``                (role ``user``)\n  - assistant text:   ``{\"text\": \"...\"}``                (role ``model``)\n  - assistant reasoning: ``{\"text\": \"...\", \"thought\": true}``\n  - tool call:        ``{\"functionCall\": {\"id\", \"name\", \"args\"}}``\n  - tool result:      ``{\"functionResponse\": {\"id\", \"name\", \"response\": {...}}}``\n    (carried on a ``type:\"tool_result\"`` record whose ``message.role`` is ``user``)\n\nNote the assistant role on disk is the Gemini ``\"model\"`` string, which we\nnormalise to ``\"assistant\"`` for the unified Event schema.\n\nTokens ARE on disk. Assistant records carry ``usageMetadata`` with\n``promptTokenCount`` / ``candidatesTokenCount`` / ``thoughtsTokenCount`` /\n``totalTokenCount`` / ``cachedContentTokenCount``. The reader now ships here, so\n``pip install clawmetry`` observes Qwen Code with no account, no licence key\nand no wheel download. ``tests/test_phase4_adapter_move.py`` pins that.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport dataclasses\nimport glob\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom
